## About
White Marsh Muffler & Brakes is a small shop, family owned and operated. John, the owner, is ASE Certified and oversees all the work done here, so the job gets done right the first time. Because we keep the shop small, our overhead stays low and the savings go to you.
We work on domestic, European and Asian vehicles, and we'll explain whatever your car needs in plain terms. We use up to date diagnostic equipment, and there isn't much John can't diagnose and fix.
We also build performance and show cars. Custom exhaust, headers, engines, rewiring, dashes and gauges, rear differentials, suspensions and restorations are some of our specialties. Customers rate us 4.9 from 114 Google reviews.

## Services
- Custom dual exhaust: Built in stainless steel or aluminized tubing, along with headers and remote electric exhaust cut-outs.
- Active exhaust bypass: For Dodge, Jeep and Chrysler models with active exhaust. Made of stainless steel, it locks your active exhaust open without turning on your check engine light. Call for details.
- Brake service and ABS repair: Brake service and repairs, including anti-lock brake systems.
- Performance and stock engine rebuilds: Engine service, repairs, tuning and full rebuilds.
- Electrical diagnosis and repair: Tracking down electrical problems, plus power window and door lock repair.
- Transmission service and repairs
- Steering and suspension: Steering and suspension service, plus suspension lifts.
- Pre-purchase vehicle evaluations: Have us look over a car before you buy it.
- Regular maintenance service: The everyday upkeep that keeps your car running.

## FAQ
Q: Do you charge for inspections and estimates?
A: Inspections and estimates are free on most of our work.

Q: Do you guarantee your work?
A: Yes. We provide a service guarantee for all of the work done with us.

Q: What kinds of vehicles do you work on?
A: We work on all domestic, European and Asian vehicles.

Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: No, the shop is closed Saturday and Sunday. We're open Monday through Friday.

Q: How can I get a quote?
A: Give us a call, or email whitemarshmuffler@gmail.com with your questions.
